placementPolicy.stableKey: FNV-1a uint32 of ASCII worldSeed/zoneId/cellE/cellN/candidateIndex; placementSeed implementation in src/domain/geography.mjs
placementPolicy.note: No global random stream; dry ground and slopes filtered before placement. Exposed roots reflect drainage, erosion and age. Density numbers are authored starting values, not an FPS promise.

calibration.method: Shire map establishes gate-to-mouth offset (~25.4 km north) using the ten-mile bridge/ferry reference as approximate calibration. Strachey mile grid establishes interior distances. Fixed landmarks rounded and locally reconciled with narrative; not literal tracing.
calibration.warning: 20% is an authored working envelope, not statistical confidence. Eastern/southern boundary reconstructed; frame bounds are not forest size.

decisions.decision: Upper Withywindle flows mainly west, lower course bends southwest. Follow final narrative at eastern eaves.
Northward departure from Bald Hill precedes east/south turn; do not copy the southward-looking exit drawn by Strachey.
All numeric elevations and channel widths authored. Relative uphill/downhill constraints follow text. No regional sea-level claim.
ArdaCraft reviewed as interpretation; its northeast label for house is not evidence overriding the book.
Do not fill western arrival corridor with dense understory; keep local root-dominated floor. Other zones use a mosaic.

gaps: Original print copies and publisher-authenticated scans not inspected; reproduction hosts identified.
Fonstad text inspected; original map contour geometry not digitized.
Tolkien drawings give no complete surveyed forest boundary or numeric heights.
All procedural streams except gully_brook are authored; source headwater location is uncertain.
Narrative route is one dated traversal, not proof of permanent paths.

research.scope: Primary narrative and published-map reproductions; secondary cartographic reconciliation; ecology. See each registry status; adaptations do not establish coordinates.
